axes.name: pointer_storage
axes.rationale: Bounded pointer-lifetime test: hold the named far-array element address once for both the condition and decrement; second variant changes only the local pointer's register storage hint, subject to MSC7 acceptance.

semantic_summary: Starting from the signed/signed named-flat-owner attempt, test whether a local far pointer retained within each inner iteration lets C7 reuse one computed PherMapBN address for compare and decrement.
binding_evidence: Target ColonySmellBN performs one segment 8 selector load and one DS switch, then computes SI once and reuses [SI] for the compare and decrement. The pointer lifetime is scoped to one band/cell access and preserves the existing named owner and bounds.
